text: A股转基因板块午后拉升，万向德农涨停，敦煌种业此前封板，秋乐种业涨超13%，神农种业、康农种业涨超8%。
text_en: A-shares' genetically modified organism sector surged in the afternoon, with Wanxiang De'nong hitting the daily limit, Dunhuang Seed previously sealing the limit, Qiule Seed rising more than 13%, and Shennong Seed and Kangnong Seed rising more than 8%.
